note: 16 cards under our own names only (no MBTI or 16personalities names), each mapped to an axis preset; axes 0..100, 0 = inward/concrete/logic/planned/steady. steady-guide is the all-50 release default. PT names and descriptions never gender Unfold or the being (nouns and verbs, no adjectives about it). shipped marks the cards offered for a new choice: a card that fails review is set shipped=false, never removed, so a Self saved on it still loads. rth-self parse_cards pins these rules.
